中士厉声下达命令。

en: to buy or obtain something quickly because it is cheap or you want it very much
ex: All the best bargains were snapped up within hours.
所有最划得来的便宜货几小时之内就被抢购一空了。

zh: a social media service that allows you to send or share photos, short videos and messages. Photos, etc. sent or shared using this service disappear from view after a short time.
en: a social media service that allows you to send or share photos, short videos and messages. Photos, etc. sent or shared using this service disappear from view after a short time.

in a way that is lively or quick

他对讲话做了精练的概括。

它是美洲短吻鳄和鳄龟等濒危物种的重要栖息地。

套索把兔子的脚套住了。
